SafeMath.safeAdd performs checked addition a+b and requires c >= a.
SafeMath.safeSub performs checked subtraction a-b requiring b <= a.
SafeMath.safeMul performs checked multiplication a*b requiring a == 0 or c/a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv performs checked division a/b requiring b > 0.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner into newOwner.
Function that lets msg.sender claim ownership if it equals newOwner, transferring ownership and clearing newOwner.
RedCarpetToken constructor initializing token metadata, total supply and initial balance.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub and safeAdd on balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' decrementing balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] with safeSub.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval, enabling reentrancy.
Payable fallback function that always reverts.
onlyOwner function calling ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens), an arbitrary external call.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, balance updates and allowance keys.
External callback ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) invoked inside approveAndCall after state update.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied token address.
Unchecked arithmetic _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() (Solidity 0.4.x has no built-in overflow checks).
